summary: Unlock your potential with our Growth Mindset Training Course. Learn strategies to embrace challenges and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
lede: Growth mindset training helps leaders make learning, feedback and skill development part of how they manage teams through change. It is for managers responsible for team capability, and develops skills in spotting mindset triggers, applying coaching and growth-oriented feedback, and linking learning goals with performance goals.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for leaders who operate in high-stakes environments where adaptability and continuous improvement are critical for success.
modules: Leading Through Digital and AI Transformation
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in a supervisory or management role. No prior knowledge of psychology is required, though familiarity with basic performance management systems is recommended. A laptop is required for digital diagnostic exercises and roadmap development.
